$comment: Declares how each part of the vault relates to its counterpart vault. Read by system/scripts/sync-check.py. Three layer kinds: 'lockstep' files must be byte-identical and any difference is actionable; 'ported' files are EXPECTED to differ (sanitization) and are tracked with a three-way ledger so only genuine changes surface; 'local' files are never compared. Paths are glob patterns relative to the vault root.

lockstep.description: Mechanism. Sterile by construction, must be identical in both vaults. Authored public-first and pulled into the private vault. Deliberately an explicit allowlist rather than a glob: the private vault carries many scripts that are private-only (Linear bridges, archivers, board reconciliation) and a glob over system/scripts/*.py would demand they be published. Mechanism is a small named set -- adding a file here is a decision to share it.

ported.description: Contract prose. Expected to differ because the public copy is sanitized. Authored private-first and hand-ported outward. Tracked three-way so only real changes flag.

local.description: Never compared. Notes, identity, generated adapters (each vault regenerates its own from its own registry), and per-machine config.

sterility_denylist.$comment: Tokens that must never appear in the public repo. Used by test_sterile.py to block a careless port, and by sync-check.py to classify a diff hunk as sanitization-only (and therefore not a portable change worth flagging).
